tools.description: Show the solver a transformed copy of an input already shown: name the base ('example', or 'demo 1', 'demo 2', ...) and one transform -- rot90, rot180, rot270, flip_h, flip_v, transpose, swap_colours_A_B, recolour_A_to_B, shift_down_1/shift_up_1/shift_left_1/shift_right_1 (the environment lists which apply to each base). A copy the rule leaves unchanged is held once; a copy identical to an input already shown is refused. Counts as one demonstration.
